climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in Central Victoria with about 720 acres of vines. Chardonnay leads plantings at 25%, followed by Pinot Noir and Sauvignon Blanc.
